decisions.rationale: Diff grants auditors deletion authority contrary to the administrator-or-owner requirement; the committed suite fails.
For restricted ASCII input, strip plus casefold implements the required trimming and lowercasing; the committed test passes.
Non-empty behavior satisfies the specification, but empty-sequence behavior is explicitly unspecified, so its intended preservation cannot be validated.
Malformed and out-of-range inputs now return zero instead of raising ConfigError; the committed suite fails.
The candidate negates the arithmetic sum and the committed test fails with -10 instead of 10.

strategy_update: Used exact scoped diffs and committed tests for every fixture; abstained only where the specification left the disputed behavior undefined.
